title: Concert Attire Order Windows by Registration Date: Group, Winter and Individual Orders (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
The Fine Arts concert attire schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** names a group order date of 2026-09-15 and a winter order date of 2026-11-15. For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, an order amount is added to the total by the registration date: 12.00 when it is after 2026-11-15, 8.00 when it is after 2026-09-15 but on or before 2026-11-15, and nothing otherwise.

| Registration date | Order amount |
|---|---|
| on or before 2026-09-15 | nothing |
| 2026-09-16 through 2026-11-15 | 8.00 |
| 2026-11-16 or later | 12.00 |

**Boundaries.** The order dates themselves belong to the earlier band: a registration on 2026-09-15 adds nothing, on 2026-09-16 adds 8.00; on 2026-11-15 it adds 8.00, on 2026-11-16 it adds 12.00.
